title: eBird Checklist Daily Event Volume
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ebird:checklist
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(location_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many eBird checklist events land each day and how many distinct location values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest eBird checklist records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct location values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back how much eBird checklist activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
